items.quote: Blue Star Segment-II Results, which I have been explaining for the past two quarters, does not include Commercial Air Conditioning and it does not include Commercial Air Conditioning. In our case, it includes the Room Air Conditioners, it includes the Commercial Refrigeration product.

items.statement: Dividend of Rs. 9 per share recommended for FY25, up from Rs. 7 per share in FY24
items.quote: In view of the record revenue and profits earned by the company, a dividend of Rs. 9 per share, previous year Rs. 7 per share, is recommended by the Board of Directors of the company.

items.statement: Net cash position improved to Rs. 640.35 Cr as of March 31, 2025 from Rs. 455.9 Cr a year earlier
items.quote: The company reported a net cash position of Rs. 640.35 Cr as of March 31, 2025, as compared to a net cash position of Rs. 455.9 Cr as of March 31, 2024.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments, commodity price volatility, supply chain disruptions, and unpredictable weather remain key risks for FY26
items.quote: Of course, we have to keep a close watch on geopolitical developments, potential volatility in commodity prices and supply chain disruptions.

items.statement: Commercial Refrigeration recovered in Q4 FY25 with >25% growth in April 2025 after regulatory and supply chain issues in H1
items.quote: That business, as I had mentioned earlier, has grown significantly in April '25. It's more than 25% growth, whereas in the last quarter it was flat.

items.statement: K.V. Sridhar joined recently as Chief Financial Officer with rich experience and Board exposure
items.quote: K.V. Sridhar, just as an introduction, he has joined us recently as Chief Financial Officer. And he comes with a very, very rich experience, and he's dealt with Board, and he's been in the system with us for last few days.

items.statement: Management refuses to give volume growth guidance for RACs, says it depends on summer season
items.quote: But it will all depend on the summers. And it's very difficult to gi ve you any kind of guidance as to what kind of percentage growth we'll be able to

items.statement: Unseasonal rains and delayed summer onset hurt consumer sentiment and secondary sales in April
items.quote: There have been some unseasonal rains and thunderstorms in some part of the country and which has brought down the sentiment -- consumer sentiments.

items.statement: UCP segment volume grew 36% YoY in FY25, revenue grew 30% to INR10,614 cr
items.quote: Overall, primary volume growth for the UCP category for the year was recorded at almost 36%.

items.statement: Voltas maintained ~19% market share in room ACs as of March 2025
items.quote: Voltas maintains its leade rship positions with a year -on-year market share of almost 19% as of March 2025

items.statement: UCP margins improved due to better product mix (premium ACs, large coolers) and value engineering
items.quote: One, of course, the better product mix has happened. Like in air coolers, there is a better demand for the larger capacity industri al kind of coolers, which is more than 100, 120 liters, etcetera, and which is a slightly better margin fetching products

items.statement: RAC margins hovering around 9-10% in UCP category, consistent with prior guidance
items.quote: And if you recollect my previous discussions with you also and the guidance which I had given you, it's been hovering around 9%, 10% all along in the UCP category.

items.statement: Projects carry-forward order book exceeds INR6,500 cr as of March 31, 2025
items.quote: As of 31st March '25, the total carry forward order book for the segment is in excess of INR6,500 crores.

items.statement: Chennai RAC factory commercial production progressing as planned, further scale-up planned
items.quote: The company's ramp-up of its manufacturing capacity is on track with commercial production from the room air conditioner facility in Chennai, Tamil Nadu is progressing as planned.

items.statement: State incentives for Chennai factory spread over 15 years, but primary objective was market proximity
items.quote: Actually, there is a state benefit definitely there, which is going to come as we produce. But it is over a longer period, over the next 15 years, I think 15 years, we are going to get the dividends in -- from this factory.

items.statement: No immediate price hike planned; evaluating commodity and forex movements
items.quote: We are also bearing in mind the commodity price movements and also the forex movement. And accordingly, a judgmental call will be taken as and when we feel it appropriate. Immediately, I'm not looking at any price hike to be honest.

items.statement: Discounting unlikely currently as channel inventories settled and summer expected to be extended
items.quote: Right now, the channel as well as the brands are settled with the inventories. So if the summer season is not setting in appropriately and if the summers are delayed and in case some brands resort to the discounting, I cannot say on that. But looks unlikely.

items.statement: Custom duty demand notice of ~INR25 cr received on copper tubes imported under FTA
items.quote: The notice -- demand notice was on copper as an element, if you're talking about what particular item was it.

items.statement: Provision of ~INR40 cr made for expected credit loss on delayed payments in GCC international projects
items.quote: About INR40-odd crores approximately.

items.statement: Domestic projects face collection challenges; optimistic of recovery in subsequent quarters
items.quote: However, in domestic business, we face challenges in collections in certain projects. We are relatively optimistic of recovery in the subsequent quarters.

items.statement: Air cooler sales grew over 70% in FY25, achieved 8.5% market share, now top 3 brand
items.quote: The air cooler segment experienced significant growth of over 70%, this year.

items.statement: Voltas Beko volume grew 57% in FY25; market share 8.7% washing machines, 5.3% refrigerators (Feb YTD)
items.quote: During the financial year ended March 2025, the industry reported only single-digit growth in washing machines and negligible growth in refrigerators. However, Voltas Beko's performed remarkably well with a volume growth of 57%.

items.statement: Commercial Refrigeration revenue grew ~19-20% in Q4 FY25 but profitability marginal due to QCO liquidation and demand issues
items.quote: And going forward, if you were talking about revenue for quarter 4 and we have grown by about overall 19%, 20% in the category, Commercial Refrigeration category. And profitability, we have not done well, to be honest, in this Commercial Refrigeration category.

items.statement: Commercial Refrigeration FY25 profitability muted due to inventory liquidation and lower customer capex
items.quote: The Commercial Refrigeration (CR) segment encountered challenges during the year linked to inventory liquidation and lower customer capital expenditures affected margins during the year.

items.statement: Commercial AC and Commercial Refrigeration expected to deliver double-digit growth in FY26
items.quote: Very difficult to say on the percentage growth. But yes, we will be -- it will be more than double-digit growth, yes.

items.statement: AC market has 60-65 brands; aspiration to regain higher share but focus on maintaining leadership with gap to #2
items.quote: There are more than 60, 65 brands which are fighting for getting this share into the pie. And therefore, it becomes very, very difficult to maintain a very high-level market share.

items.statement: QCO implementation impacted Commercial Refrigeration demand and inventory liquidation in FY25
items.quote: where we had some challenges in demand and also due to because the QCO was coming up and also there was commodity costs going up, which industry player could not pass on to the consumer.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 24% to INR15,737 cr, PBT up 145% to INR1,191 cr, PAT up to INR834 cr in FY25
items.quote: For the year ended 31 March 2025, the company reported a 24% increase in consolidated total income, reaching INR15,737 crores, up from INR12,734 crores in the same period last year. Profit before tax surged by 145%, amounting to INR1,191 crores compared to INR481 crores previously.

items.statement: Projects segment turned around to INR169 cr profit in FY25 from INR328 cr loss; Q4 loss narrowed to INR2 cr
items.quote: The segment results was a positive INR169 crores, a significant turnaround from a loss of INR328 crores last year. For the quarter, segment revenue was INR1,138 crores compared to INR1,098 crores in the same quarter. Losses have reduced from INR1,08 crores to INR2 crores

items.statement: Global uncertainty from US tariffs, China slowdown, Indo-Pak tensions may impact economic activity
items.quote: the global economic outlook, as you can see, linked to multiple factors like U.S. tariffs and counterme asures of the trading partners. There is a high level of uncertainty. In addition to the risk of increased inflation, investment and consumer confidence are anticipated to decline during the prevailing uncertainties

items.statement: Other income jumped due to interest, mark-to-market gains on investments and PLI incentive accrual
items.quote: This is largely the interest and mark-to-market income on our investments in other income. And this year, it has paid us good dividends. And in other operating income we have accrued PLI linked incentive.

items.statement: FY26 volume growth guided at around 10% (+/-1%) with potential upside
items.quote: Yes. I think volume growth will be in the range of 10% , (+/-1%), maybe it can be more than 10% also .

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin guidance of Rs. 9 to Rs. 11 per scm, possibly Rs. 9.5 to Rs. 11
items.quote: With respect to the margins, we have just discussed maybe Rs. 9 to Rs. 11 is the right guidance for the next financial year.

items.statement: FY26 capex guidance of Rs. 1,300 crores for MGL and Rs. 150 crores for UEPL
items.quote: We are expecting around Rs. 1,300 crores CAPEX for FY '26, and again around Rs. 150 crores will be in UEPL.

items.statement: Capex breakup: ~Rs. 300 crores CNG, ~Rs. 500 crores PNG including pipelines, ~Rs. 200 crores pipelines, ~Rs. 100 crores replacement
items.quote: As Rajesh mentioned, around Rs. 300 crores will be for CNG , around Rs. 500 crores will be for P NG, including pipelines. Pipelines will be another Rs. 200 crores and OPEX will be around Rs. 100 crores.

items.statement: Added 24 CNG stations in Q4 FY25, total 385 stations; laid 236 km pipeline in Q4, total 7,459 km
items.quote: We also added 24 stations during this quarter. With this, we have overall 385 stations as on 31st March 2025.

items.statement: UEPL added 26 stations in FY25, total 82 stations; laid 95.63 km pipeline, total 361 km
items.quote: UEPL has added 26 stations during this year, which has taken its total number to 82.

items.statement: FY25 consolidated sales volume 4.235 mmscmd, up from 3.738 mmscmd in FY24
items.quote: In the year ending this Financial Year 31st March 2025, MGL as a consolidated entity has achieved total sales volume of 4.235 mmscmd.

items.statement: CNG vehicle additions hit record 98,215 in FY25 vs 77,000 in FY24; total CNG vehicles now 1.1 million
items.quote: And if you see overall conversion for the year, this is highest in the history of MG L, that is 98,215 number of conversions happened during the year against around 77,000 the last year.

items.statement: Q4 FY25 EBITDA Rs. 378 crores (+20% YoY); FY25 EBITDA Rs. 1,510 crores (-18% YoY) due to lower APM allocation and higher gas cost
items.quote: EBITDA from operations for the financial year is Rs. 1,510 crores, as compared to the previous financial year EBITDA of Rs. 1,843 crores, reduction is mainly due to reduction in APM allocation and an increase in gas cost impacting margins adversely.

items.statement: Q4 FY25 unit EBITDA ~Rs. 10/scm; FY25 unit EBITDA ~Rs. 10/scm
items.quote: Coming to your EBITDA margin, this quarter we have earned around Rs. 10. And on the whole for the year is again Rs. 10.

items.statement: APM allocation reduced to 1.67 mmscmd in April; NWG increased to 0.65 mmscmd; APM ceiling $6.75/MMBTU at 12% of Indian crude basket
items.quote: So, now I think the allocation of APM has come down to around 1.67 mmscmd. B ut correspondingly, there is an increase in the NWG available which is around 0.65 mmscmd

items.statement: Crude at $62/bbl below $67.5 ceiling will lower APM and NWG procurement costs, improving margins
items.quote: crude remains below $67.5 per barrel then the APM prices will come down, and similarly 12% to IBC will also be on the lower side, because earlier the crude was trading in the range of $75 or $80. So this benefit will lower the procurement cost on the average procurement basis for the total portfolio

items.statement: I&C volume target 0.9-1.0 mmscmd in next couple of years from current 0.6-0.7 mmscmd; addressable FO/liquid fuel market 1.0-1.1 mmscmd
items.quote: Our current I &C sale, which is between 0.6 mmscmd to 0.7 mmscmd, we can foresee that going up to about 0.9 mmscmd or 1.0 mmscmd in the next couple of years or so.

items.statement: I&C growth driven by 3-10% discount vs alternate fuel without floor and physical pipeline connectivity to large industries
items.quote: There are two main drivers to this growth, one is the call which we took that we will guarantee the customer a 3% or 10% discount on this alternate fuel without any floor.

items.statement: Bombay HC committee on EV transition holding positive discussions; report expected in a month
items.quote: Several meetings have been held, and we will submit our report, maybe, in a month's time to the High Court, and then it will be disclosed to the public.

items.statement: PNGRB high-powered committee on open access; infrastructure exclusivity extension applied for two areas; marketing exclusivity outcome subject to Delhi HC
items.quote: In two of our areas we have already applied, and it can get, I mean, PNGRB is considering for extension of that. And word over what we have found is that infrastructure exclusivity is generally available to the entity which is working in that area.

items.statement: Industry pushing for CNG excise duty elimination and natural gas inclusion in GST; discussions ongoing with PNGRB, MoPNG, Finance Ministry
items.quote: In fact, our regulator PNGRB has also been following it up with ministry for, one, elimination of excise duty on the CNG, as well as LCNG also. And second is the inclusion of gas in the GST.

items.statement: Final dividend Rs. 18/share approved; total FY25 dividend Rs. 30/share (300% of face value)
items.quote: I am happy to announce that the Board of Directors has approved a total final dividend of Rs. 18 per equity share for this financial year. The total dividend for the year, including interim dividend already paid, is Rs. 30 per share, that is 300% on the face value of Rs. 10 per equity share.

items.statement: UEPL merger into MGL in process; 3EV JV: 32% equity committed, Rs. 96 crores, Rs. 23 crores balance, 850 vehicles produced in FY25
items.quote: We have 3EV we have already committed for 32% equity and then with the capital of around Rs. 96 crores. So that was linked with certain progress to be made. So we have paid three tranches, and around Rs. 23 crores is balance.

items.statement: International Battery Company JV: 1 GW committed in first two phases, scaling to 5 GW; 40% equity from MGL; plant expected in 12-15 months
items.quote: With respect to the International Battery Company , IBC, we have committed for 1 gigawatt in the first two phases and following it up to scale up to maximum 5 gigawatts. Currently the company has been formed, we have got the land, and the site work has started. So maybe within 12 to 14, 15 months the plant should be in place.

items.statement: LNG trucking: Savroli station selling 4 tons/day; MLPL Aurangabad operational, Seoni commissioning by Q1 FY26, Amravati and JNPT by Q3 FY26; target 10-12 more stations in Maharashtra
items.quote: Two more stations, one in Amravati, Amravati has already started construction, and JNPT station will also be completed in this financial year, probably by Q3 of this year. We see a very good potential . As we keep on adding the stations we are getting the customer.

items.statement: OPEX increase driven by volume-linked costs (CNG dispensing, transport), Q4 maintenance Rs. 15-17 crores, CSR Rs. 22-23 crores (up from Rs. 16-17 crores), sales promotion Rs. 32-34 crores
items.quote: And apart from that, some of the one -time expenses, like sales promotion, we have taken up in this Q4 mainly the drive to do lot of maintenance of the old pipeline, old equipments, etc. And as I earlier said, this year CSR expenditure on a yearly basis is also more because average profit of last three-years was up.

items.statement: GA-wise volumes: GA1 1.93 mmscmd, GA2 1.88 mmscmd, GA3 0.25 mmscmd
items.quote: 1.93 mmscmd was sale for GA 1. 1.88 mmscmd is volume for GA-2. And balance around 0.25 mmscmd or 2,50,000 scmd is for GA 3.

items.statement: EBITDA margins depend on dynamic alternate fuel prices, procurement costs, pass-through ability, and geopolitical factors
items.quote: Because EBITDA margins depend on the alternate fuel price, the procurement cost, our margins and how much we can absorb, how much we can pass on to bring more stability into CNG prices.

items.statement: Segment-I margin guidance for FY26 at 7.5%; Segment-II at 8.5% with attempt to reach 9%
items.quote: The guidance for FY26, unless and until something dramatically changes remain, for Segment-I, 7.5%; and Segment-II, 8.5%. And we will attempt to take it to 9%, and that will be with a great difficulty, I think.

items.statement: April industry sales declined 15-20%; Blue Star grew ~5% vs internal target of 25-30%
items.quote: April, I understand, the industry would have degrown anywhere between 15% to 20%. In our case, as I can disclose this since the Board Meeting is over, we would have grown by around 5%.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 RAC growth outlook revised to 10-15%, up to 20% if lucky, after muted April
items.quote: As we sit and see now with a muted April, I would down it to say 10% to 15% growth, and if extremely lucky, it will be 20% growth, because one-month has gone, another seven days have gone.

items.statement: Carried forward order book rose 9.9% to Rs 6,263.4 crore as of March 31, 2025
items.quote: Carried forward order book as of March 31, '25, grew by 9.9% to Rs. 6,263.4 Cr as compared to Rs. 5,697.6 Cr as of March 31, '24.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved 40 bps to 7.3% in FY25; Segment-I at 8.2%, Segment-II at 8.4%
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved by 40 bps from 6.9% in FY24 to 7.3% in FY25.

items.statement: Price hikes of 3-4% in January and 4-5% from April 1 to pass on input cost increases
items.quote: There was 3% to 4% taken in January, 4% to 5% from April 1.

items.statement: Signed MOU with Hindalco for local copper tube sourcing; domestic capacity commissioned
items.quote: As I mentioned in the opening remark, with Hindalco we were the first one to sign the MOU for sourcing. There are two other players as well who will be making copper tubes here, including Adani and MedTube.

items.statement: Compressor supply secured till end of summer 2026; evaluating CKD assembly and indigenous design
items.quote: On all angles, we believe , at least for FY26, we are fully secured , till the end of summer 2026 we are fully secured. Nothing to worry.

items.statement: Energy labelling change expected in 2026, next in 2028; EPR rate tripled from Rs 9/kg to Rs 23/kg
items.quote: Our anticipation is, there will be indeed a change in 2026, and the next change will be 2028, with higher parameters.

items.statement: EPR provision of ~Rs 10 crore last year, expected to rise to ~Rs 30 crore in coming year
items.quote: As far as Blue Star exact figure, do not worry, it is in the order of Rs. 10 Cr, which will go up to Rs. 30 Cr in the coming year.

items.statement: Capital employed increased to Rs 2,427.3 crore due to fixed capital investment; committed to R&D, manufacturing, distribution, digitalization
items.quote: Capital employed as of March 31, 2025 increased to Rs. 2,427.3 Cr as compared to Rs. 2,156.7 Cr as of March 31, 2024. This was primarily owing to investment in fixed capital.

items.statement: R&D investment guided at 1.5-2% of revenue; backward integration progressing across components except refrigerant
items.quote: So, clear guideline is that whether it is room air conditioner or a deep freezer or it is a commercial air conditioning system, 1.5% to 2% of our revenue will be invested in R&D.

items.statement: Room AC market share gained 100 bps to ~14%; volume crossed 1.53 million units in FY25
items.quote: Our market share now stands close to 14%.

items.statement: International business: 3 OEMs approved in US/Europe, commercial shipments started; more clarity expected H2 FY26
items.quote: In FY25, we have developed products for 3 OEMs in the US and Europe and after completion of field trials of the products, commercial shipments have begun.

items.statement: Segment-II margin improvement driven by Room AC scale benefits; Commercial Refrigeration flat in Q4 but recovered in April
items.quote: The margin for FY25 has improved to 8.4% from 7.8% in FY24, aided by strong revenue growth in Room AC business, leading to a benefit from economies of scale.

items.statement: Net cash position improved to Rs 640.35 crore from Rs 455.9 crore
items.quote: The company reported a net cash position of Rs. 640.35 Cr as of March 31, 2025, as compared to a net cash position of Rs. 455.9 Cr as of March 31, 2024.

items.statement: Dividend recommended at Rs 9 per share, up from Rs 7 previous year
items.quote: In view of the record revenue and profits earned by the company, a dividend of Rs. 9 per share, previous year Rs. 7 per share, is recommended by the Board of Directors of the company.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments, commodity price volatility, supply chain disruptions, and unpredictable weather cited as key risks for FY26
items.quote: Of course, we have to keep a close watch on geopolitical developments, potential volatility in commodity prices and supply chain disruptions.

items.statement: Variable pay and sales incentives linked to sales growth; employees may face pain in weak summer
items.quote: It can create pain for the employees associated, because the variable pay or sales incentive will be linked to the sales growth. So, there is a pain they will undergo, indeed.

items.statement: Management expects double-digit revenue growth and EBITDA growth ahead of revenue growth in FY26
items.quote: we remain confident of delivering EBITDA growth ahead of revenue growth and our sharp focus on CAPEX and interest costs positions us well for continued PAT growth and ROCE improvement

items.statement: Management targets ROCE to cross 20% in short term with further expansion long term
items.quote: We believe that in the short term, we should definitely cross 20, but long term this ROCE can expand even faster

items.statement: Capex for FY26 planned at Rs 380-390 crore including Thailand Greenfield
items.quote: Next year, our plan is to spend around Rs. 380-Rs. 390 crore and that should be sufficient to cover for both the growth plans as well as the Thailand Greenfield

items.statement: Brazil capacity expansion of 40 million tubes/year for Beauty & Cosmetics operational in Q1 FY26
items.quote: in terms of volume contribution is going to be about 40 million tubes a year, right, which is the expansion of Brazil, right

items.statement: Thailand Greenfield to start small in H2 FY26 and scale rapidly with customer orders
items.quote: Thailand, we are making an entry as we have said, and the objective in Thailand actually is to start small but scale up fast

items.statement: Beauty & Cosmetics grew over 20% in Q4 FY25 with healthy order pipeline and new customer wins
items.quote: Beauty & Cosmetics witnessed over 20% growth, fueled by focused investments in capability and technology, adoption of new theme, deeper customer engagement as well as sharper execution

items.statement: India tube revenue growth at mid-to-high single digit excluding laminate sales
items.quote: Yes, it is mid-to-high single-digit

items.statement: Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin at 20%+ with 11th consecutive quarter of expansion
items.quote: This marks the 11th consecutive quarter of EBITDA margin expansion supported by sustained double-digit EBITDA growth. Our margins remain robust at 20% plus

items.statement: India margins improved 100bps YoY and 170bps QoQ in Q4 FY25
items.quote: In India, margins have shown a clear recovery in line with our commitment. We saw 100 basis points year-on-year improvement and 170 basis points sequential increase

items.statement: Full year FY25 EBITDA margin expanded 169bps with all regions contributing
items.quote: EBITDA rose by 17.5% with margin expansion of 169 basis points

items.statement: Healthy order pipeline in Beauty & Cosmetics with new customer wins across geographies
items.quote: Our order pipeline remains healthy with new customer wins across geographies backed by Neo Seam tubes and superior printing capabilities

items.statement: Raw material costs benign and range-bound with contractual pass-through to customers
items.quote: I would say that raw materials basically have been, I would say, benign, if I can use that word and prices of all the key commodities have been kind of range bound

items.statement: US tariff impact minimal due to local US manufacturing and contractual duty pass-through
items.quote: we expect minimal impact of US tariffs as we have local manufacturing in the US. Also, our export to the US is relatively small. Further, EPL has contractual pass through of duties with most customers

items.statement: Personal Care & Beyond now 48% of total business, grew 10.3% vs Oral Care 5.6% in FY25
items.quote: Our category mix continued to evolve in the right direction with Personal Care & Beyond growing at 10.3% , nearly double the 5.6% growth in O ral Care. This segment now contributes 48% of our total business

items.quote: Our sustainable tube mix has risen to 33%, up from 21% last year

items.quote: In India, we are really going aggressively after all the D2C brands, for instance, so we are expanding our customer base

items.statement: Low market share in Beauty & Cosmetics in Europe and Americas with aggressive growth plans
items.quote: have very low shares in Europe and Americas , right and we have a very aggressive plan to grow in the Europe and the Americas

items.statement: Claims lowest cost producer globally by at least 3% due to frugal culture and machine efficiency

items.quote: Lots of tubes come in from China directly to the W est Coast of the US, right, and a little less so on the East Coast of the US. With our local production, we will be in a position of competitive advantage

items.statement: CDP A rating for climate change and water security, UNGC Forward Faster Sustainability Award 2025

items.statement: Reduced intercompany laminate sales optimized inventory and improved net working capital
items.quote: lower intercompany laminate sales, which helped optimize inventory levels and improve our overall networking capital

items.quote: EBITDA and PAT combined with solid cash flow generation has helped reduce our net debt to EBITDA ratio to 0.54x

items.statement: Proposed final dividend of Rs 2.50/share, total FY25 dividend Rs 5/share vs Rs 4.35 in FY24
items.quote: In FY '25, if the final dividend gets approved in the AGM, we will pay Rs. 5 per share dividend versus Rs. 4.35 paisa that we paid last year

items.statement: Hired more salespeople called hunters for Beauty & Cosmetics customer acquisition
items.quote: we have hired more salespeople which we are calling hunters to really acquire those customers

items.statement: EPS improved 44% from Rs 7.88 in FY24 to Rs 11.38 in FY25
items.quote: Consequently, our EPS has improved from Rs. 7.88 in FY '24 to 11.38 in FY '25, an improvement in EPS of 44%

items.statement: ROCE improved to 18% in FY25, up 335bps
items.quote: ROCE improving to 18%, expanding by 335 basis points

items.statement: Macro softness in India and China FMCG may delay double-digit growth but mitigation actions underway
items.quote: If the macros were a little more en abling, that would have happened earlier, but we are doing things to make sure that even if we don't see a major reversal of that, that we get there in quick time

items.statement: New Managing Director Pravin Chaudhari introduced with 25 years at Kansai Nerolac, prior CEO role at Pidilite, and senior roles at Kansai Paint Japan

items.statement: Decorative demand showing slight improvement with rural recovery continuing; industrial demand stable with government infrastructure thrust
items.quote: We all know, currently the paint industry is going through a challenging environment, particularly decorative, mainly due to new competition and stress on demand. However, off late, there has been slight improvement and we are on the growth trajectory.

items.statement: EBITDA margin contraction over 5 years driven by RM inflation and difficulty passing through to industrial; decorative margins pressured by competitive intensity and upfront investments
items.quote: So as far as last five years, if you are looking at, you know, our EBI TDA margin contraction that you are referring to, has been primarily driven by the RM thing that you would have noticed, you know, in last till 22 -23, there has been severe inflationary phase where we have found it's difficult to pass through to industrial and that's why it has led to that contraction

items.statement: Crude benefit in Q4 offset by rupee depreciation; future crude benefit depends on sustainability and contract renewals, with industrial pass-through and decorative full pass-through
items.quote: Ya. So as of now, till quarter 4, actually it is set off. Whatever crude benefit that we got actually got offsetted by the dollar. But yes, beyond this, if it comes, there will be some pass through also will happen as far as industrial is concerned.

items.statement: Paint+ salience reached double-digits with 190 bps increase in last year; 20+ new products launched in last year, many unique or at new price points
items.quote: Happy to say, in 3yrs.,this has actually borne fruit. Today we have a double-digit salience in Paint+ and in the last 1yr., we have progressed by 190 basis points, and we have a whole host of products which we keep bringing out in 3 the Paint+ range

items.statement: Influencer program expanded: Paint as a Service in 250 cities, 8000+ architects onboard in 45+ cities, 1 lakh+ painters in Pragati program with increased secondary salience
items.quote: Today we are present in 250 cities. The salience of paint as a service keeps on increasing in the decorative business for us. We have a very sustained program for architects and interior designers. Today, we are present in 45+ cities, almost 8000 architects are almost onboard. items.quote: On the cover glass, we have allocated the capex for Rs. 40 crores which is going to happen during this year and the next year.

items.quote: Due to significant new business opportunities, we plan to invest an additional capex of around Rs. 40 to 45 crores during FY26 to increase production capacity at our SJS plant in Bangalore.

items.statement: Net cash position of Rs. 991.7 million at FY25 end; strong balance sheet supports strategic expansion
items.quote: Additionally, cash and cash equivalent s stood at Rs. 1,150.1 million, positioning the Company with a net cash balance of Rs. 991.7 million. Strong free cash flow strengthened our ability to pursue future growth and strategic investments

items.statement: No fund raise mentioned; growth funded through internal accruals and net cash position

items.quote: So, by next year is when we think that we will actively work on an acquisition. At the moment, we are collecting gunpowder.
