items.statement: Eldeco Hanging Gardens launched in April 2025 with 70% inventory booked in first week
items.quote: Though, I must tell you that we got a phenomenal response with nearly 70% inventory booked within first week of launch.

items.statement: Eldeco Salano Garden township project on 50 acres with GDV of Rs.1,000 crore planned for Diwali launch
items.quote: The project, under the name of Eldeco Salano Garden, has a gross development value of about Rs.1,000 crores.

items.statement: Eldeco Hanging Garden and Skywalk GDV approximately Rs.180-190 crore each, total Rs.360 crore
items.quote: About Rs.180-190 crore each. Prem Poddar: So both go together, right sir? Pankaj Bajaj: No each, so put together about Rs.360 crores.

items.statement: Imperia Phase-2 gross margins expected upwards of 40-45%, weighted average gross margin in early 30% range
items.quote: So, Phase-2 will start getting recognized this year, because we are targeting to apply for completion certificate sometime in October and receive them by say December, and I hope in the last quarter we start recognizing revenue, in which our margin will be much higher there, upwards of 40% if not 45%.

items.statement: Overall gross margin on Rs.3,000-3,500 crore GDV pipeline estimated at Rs.600-800 crore over 5-6 years
items.quote: So if we are going to do 3,000 crore or 3,500 crores over the next five years. Then gross margin should be about Rs.600-700 crore or Rs.800 crore, but that's gross.

items.statement: Stable realization for ongoing projects estimated at Rs.6,000-6,500 per sq ft
items.quote: So, let's take Rs. 6,000-Rs.6,500 per square foot as a stable natural realization.

items.statement: No price drop in Eldeco Trinity; expecting price uptick after sample apartment unveiling
items.quote: No, there is no price drop in fact we are awaiting the finishing of our sample apartment. We have gone a little slow on our marketing here because we want to kind of re-launch the project after our sample apartment is done.

items.statement: Land acquisition target of 100 acres in FY26 from current 31 acres, estimated outflow Rs.250 crore
items.quote: I expect that this number should reach about 100 acres this year, this 31 acres should become 100 acres. And the big one we did last year was Solano Garden, and it has already done wonders to our GDV, if we are able to take this 31 acres to 100 acres, I will be more than happy.

items.statement: Construction spend grew 60% YoY to Rs.156 crore in FY25
items.quote: Construction spend saw a growth of 60% year-on-year, and stood at Rs.156 crores.

items.statement: Imperia Phase-2 completion certificate application targeted Sep-Oct 2025, revenue recognition from Q4 FY26
items.quote: We are targeting September and October, though our commitment to our customer is sometime next year. So it's gone for an early completion we have done good execution aside. So if we apply for completion in September and October we probably get the completion certificate within a couple of months after that, so I don't expect revenue recognition to start before Quarter 4, actually.

items.statement: Eldeco Select project completion certificate expected in couple of months, revenue recognition to follow
items.quote: We are trying based on technicality on which it is stuck. So we should be able to get it closed in a couple of months. So, the moment we get the completion certificate, it will all be recognized.

items.statement: Collections grew 105% YoY to Rs.253.9 crore in FY25
items.quote: Collections for FY25 grew by 105% year-on-year to Rs.253.9 crores.

items.statement: Debt expected to increase for business development as RERA escrow cash not available for use
items.quote: So yes, going forward, given this anomaly, I do expect the loan on the Company to increase, which will primarily be for our business development.

items.statement: Related party loan earning interest expected to be repaid partly or fully during FY26
items.quote: I guess that loan will come back, but that we will figure out how quickly, because that loan is earning interest, and we are anyway sitting on surplus cash on this balance sheet. So that loan, sometime during this year we should expect for it to come back, if not full, then in parts.

items.statement: No merger planned with unlisted entity Eldeco Infrastructure; both operate in separate geographies
items.quote: There is no update on our side from this. The two entities are completely different, they don't compete with each other. We do not cherry pick projects, the listed entity works only in Lucknow it does not work outside Lucknow and unlisted Company, however attractive a project might be, it will not enter Lucknow that is left for the listed entity.

items.statement: Expansion to Gorakhpur under negotiation with landowners, no formal timeline
items.quote: Yes, most probably will expand to Gorakhpur, we are already in negotiation with some landowners there, but there is nothing formal right now that I can formally disclose.

items.statement: Lucknow market undersupplied with good infrastructure growth, but overall real estate sentiment slowing
items.quote: So the local market is very good because of infrastructure upgrade, the investment that the local government is putting into the city, the social infrastructure, the airport, everything is doing well for Lucknow, but other contradictory forces. Yes, there is an overall slowdown in the related demand and sentiments all across the country.

items.statement: Realization per sq ft grew 32% YoY to Rs.6,568 in FY25
items.quote: Realization per square foot witnessed a growth of 32% year-on-year, and stood at Rs.6,568 per square foot.

items.statement: Fresh area booked declined to 5.1 lakh sq ft in FY25 from 7.8 lakh sq ft in FY24
items.quote: FY25 was a mixed bag for us. We faced delays in approvals and launches in many of our projects with the result that our overall fresh area booked at 5.1 lakh square feet was significantly lower than last year 7.8 lakh square feet.

items.statement: RERA escrow accounts lock 70% of collections until project completion, limiting cash availability
items.quote: But the peculiar thing about real estate Company is that this cash is not available to use, and this paradox is because of the RERA guidelines which has come in, which mandate us to deposit 70% of all collection into a RERA designated escrow account which can be used only in the project.

items.statement: Eldeco Salano Garden to launch in phases: plots and villas first, then group housing components over 2-3 years
items.quote: No, it will be in phases. So we will be launching a horizontal part of the development first, by that, I mean the plots and the villas and then it has multiple vertical components, small group housing components, which will come two or three years from now.

items.statement: Strategy focused on upper mid-income aspirational segment (Rs.1.2-1.5 cr ticket), not luxury
items.quote: As an average apartment size of 1,500 or 1,800 square feet we are talking about a ticket size of Rs.1.2-1.5 crores, which by any token cannot be considered luxury it is just upper mid income aspirational kind of so that's the strategy.

items.statement: Total revenue pipeline of Rs.3,000-3,500 crore to be recognized over 5-6 years from current projects
items.quote: If you look at our unsold value and sold value for projects where revenue has not been recognized, it should be close to Rs.1,600 or Rs.1,700 crore. Then we have new launches, where GDV is Rs.1,000 crore. So total revenue which is to be recognized over the next five-six year is about Rs.3,000 crores, Rs.3,500 crore.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated topline growth expected at mid to high single digit
items.quote: And lastly, on the guidance of FY'26, we expect mid to high single digit consolidated topline growth for FY'26.

items.statement: FY26 R&D spend expected at 6% to 8% of sales
items.quote: We now expect our FY'26 R&D spend to be 6% to 8% of sales for the next year.

items.statement: Additional ~US$100 million investment for commercialization of new Specialty products in FY26
items.quote: For the current year, we are looking to invest approximately US$ 100 million additionally on commercialization of new Specialty product.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin 29%, Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin 28.7%
items.quote: EBITDA for year was Rs. 152,717 million a growth of 17.3% with resulting EBITDA margin of 29%.

items.statement: Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin 28.7% vs 25.3% in Q4 FY24 and 29.3% in Q3 FY25
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter was 28.7% compared to 25.3% in Q4 FY'24 and 29.3% in Q3 FY'25.

items.statement: India formulation sales grew 13.7% in FY25 and 13.6% in Q4 FY25, outpacing market
items.quote: Our India formulation sales for the full year FY'25 were Rs. 169,230 million, recording 13.7% growth over previous year.

items.statement: US Specialty growth driven by ILUMYA, CEQUA, WINLEVI, ODOMZO; generics declined due to competition
items.quote: The growth is driven by Specialty with all our growth products contributing like ILUMYA, CEQUA, WINLEVI and ODOMZO, but offset by a decline in generics for the full year.

items.statement: Emerging markets Q4 underlying constant currency growth 11.5% YoY
items.quote: The underlying growth in constant currency terms was 11.5% year-on-year for Q4.

items.statement: Material cost 20.7% of sales in FY25, lower due to higher Specialty share
items.quote: Material cost stands at 20.7% of sales, lower than last year on account of product mix including higher share of sales from Specialty business.

items.statement: Halol site audit requested from FDA; Mohali and Dadra remediation ongoing before audit request
items.quote: I think we have disclosed that we have requested FDA to audit Halol, they have to decide. I think most likely this may be a surprise audit, so we don't know when they are likely to audit.

items.statement: MFN policy lacks clarity on implementation; cannot assess impact on US business
items.quote: I think we have to wait for greater clarity on finally how this... because as I read it, it is kind of currently at a voluntary level. So we have no idea as to how it plays out.

items.statement: Agreed to acquire Checkpoint Therapeutics; awaiting approval and closing; UNLOXCYT approved by USFDA
items.quote: Sun Pharma has agreed to acquire Checkpoint Therapeutics, a company specializing in immunotherapy and targeted oncology. We are awaiting approval of that transaction and subsequent closing.

items.statement: Net cash $3.1 billion at consolidated level as of 31 March 2025
items.quote: As of 31st March 2025, net cash was $3.1 billion at the consolidated level.

items.statement: Final dividend Rs. 5.50 per share proposed; total FY25 dividend Rs. 16 per share vs Rs. 13.50 in FY24
items.quote: The Board has proposed a fina l dividend of Rs. 5.50 per share for year FY'25. This is in addition to the interim dividend of Rs. 10.50 per share taking the total dividend for FY'25 to Rs. 16 per share compared to Rs. 13.50 per share for FY'24

items.statement: Jayashree Satagopan joining as Global CFO effective 1 July; C.S. Muralidharan superannuating
items.quote: Ms. Jayashree Satagopan has joined Sun Pharma and will assume her role as Global Chief Financial Officer effective from 1 st of July. Concurrently, Mr. C. S. Muralidharan will be superannuating from this role

items.statement: Ilumya manufacturing transfer to US would take 2.5-3 years and significant cost
items.quote: I think both cost and time. I my view is that it will take at least 2.5-3 years before the new source is approved by the agency. And it cost a lot of money.

items.statement: US generic pricing pressure product-specific; no broad industry change
items.quote: On pricing, I think we have consistently said that it's product-specific thing, and nothing which I can speak to on a generalized basis. So product-specific, we continue to see pressure on pricing.

items.statement: R&D spend Q4 FY25 Rs. 8,116 million (6.4% of sales); Specialty R&D 36% of total
items.quote: Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q4 FY'25 stands at Rs. 8,116 million or 6.4% of sales. The Specialty R&D accounted for 36% of our total R&D spend for the quarter.

items.statement: Leqselvi US launch planned for Q2 FY26; SCD-044 topline data expected H1 CY25
items.quote: So I think in the quarter two, we will be launching this product in the US.

items.statement: Ilumya biosimilar impact from Humira/Stelara expected small; product to remain growth driver
items.quote: whatever modeling we have done so far, I mean, there will be an impact, but we think it will be a small impact and the product can continue to be a growth driver in the existing therapy as well as with the new indication that we will get.

items.statement: Tax rate expected to inch up further due to exhaustion of tax losses
items.quote: Going forward, we expect the tax rate to continue to go up on a full year basis, mainly on account of exhaustion of tax losses.

items.statement: Semaglutide planned for commercialization in focus emerging markets
items.quote: Yes, I think that's the plan.

items.statement: High global uncertainty (tariffs, currency) driving conservative FY26 guidance
items.quote: I think the correct interpretation is high l evel of global uncertainty. Because today if you look at currency fluctuations of rates in different geographies, it is very difficult to predict

items.statement: Phase 2 capex completion targeted for Q3 FY26 with meaningful contributions from end of FY27
items.quote: Completion s targeted for Q3 of the current financial year with meaningful contributions expected from end of FY 27 onwards.

items.statement: Phase 2 capex total outlay estimated at approximately INR 160 crores with modest cost overrun
items.quote: We remain committed to completing Phase 2 of the capex project within the previously communicated time frame, though now we anticipate a modest cost overrun with a total outlay estimated at approximately INR 160 crores.

items.statement: Phase 1 capex commercialized in Q4 FY25 including clean room and utilities; validation batches underway
items.quote: Despite these headwinds, we are pleased to report the successful commercialization of Phase 1 of our capex project during the quarter, which includes clean room and associated utilitics.

items.statement: Capex financed through 60-40 debt equity structure
items.quote: The capex will be financed through a 60-40 debt equity structure.

items.statement: Demand across product portfolio remained subdued in Q4 FY25 compounded by new capacity entries
items.quote: Demand across our product portfolio remained subdued during the quarter, compounded by the entry of new capacities, both within India and internationally over recent years.

items.statement: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY25 was 6.7%, up 93 bps sequentially but down 921 bps year-on-year
items.quote: The EBITDA margin for the quarter was 6.7%, an improvement of 93 basis points over Q3 FY '25, but down 921 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin contracted 653 bps to 9.2% due to competition, subdued realizations and increased operating expenses
items.quote: For FY '25, EBITDA was INR33.87 crores with a margin of 9.2%, reflecting a contraction of 653 basis points from the previous year.

items.statement: Margin erosion completely driven by pricing pressure, not cost increases; volume grew ~20% but revenue only 9%
items.quote: So, for us right now, the margin erosion is completely by the pricing pressure. We don't think that there's been any significant cost increases as such in the current year. It's mainly driven by lower realizations.

items.statement: Process reengineering initiated from March to improve margins; expects significant implementation in next 3-6 months
items.quote: We are -- today, we are working on our costs and trying to reengineer the entire processes and see how we can drive margins again. So, there is a lot of introspection going on being done - undertaken by us to get a return back to margins in a better way.

items.statement: Regulated market entry expected to add 10-15% additional margin on steady state basis
items.quote: There should be an additional at least 10% to 15% additional margin coming in.

items.statement: EU regulated market sales expected at INR 25-30 crores in FY26 from existing approvals
items.quote: We are looking at generating about INR25 crores to INR30 crores in the current year from EU sales.

items.statement: Total sales potential of INR 250-300 crores from new capex investment with asset turn of 1.6-1.7x
items.quote: We anticipate a total sales potential of close to about INR300 crores from this investment, which we are doing between INR250 crores and INR300 crores. So, the asset turn is likely to be in the range of about 1.6x, 1.7x.

items.statement: Phase 2 capex plant ready by December 2025; trial production and validations starting February 2026; meaningful sales in ~2 years
items.quote: With regard to our capex, which we are doing, we hope to have the plant ready by December this year. And trial production will typically be starting along with validations around February next year. And the entire cycle of getting the documents up and running is close to about 1.5 years, 2 years.

items.statement: Phase 1 fixed overheads currently INR 40-50 lakhs per month; substantial overheads when full plant starts by Q3 FY26
items.value: INR 40 lakhs to INR 50 lakhs per month
items.quote: We have actually commissioned only a small part right now. So, I don't think - I don' really anticipate a large surge, meaning we are probably looking at something like INR40 lakhs to INR50 lakhs per month sort of overhead over there, not more than that.

items.statement: Onboarded 5 EU customers for regulated products; some business started but not significant yet
items.quote: And with regard to long-term contracts, we have onboarded 5 customers in the EU till now for our products. And some amount of business has started. It's not very large right now, but we hope that it will start getting built up as we go along.

items.statement: Chinese companies hold 80-85% market share in veterinary API sector; competitive intensity primarily from China
items.quote: Now the competitive intensity is not so much from India as it is from China, frankly. And China has got - in this sector, China has got 80%, 85% market share. Indian companies got barely a 10%, 15% market share.

items.statement: No capacity rationalization seen yet in India or China; shakeout expected towards end of 2025
items.quote: Not yet, meaning we hope that some sort of a change will come in a little later. And normally, what happens is that the French players or the people who have set up new capacities and who don't have deep pockets normally start going out. But it not happened yet. I think the shakeout should come maybe towards the end of this year.

items.statement: Fluralaner went off patent in March 2025; NGL is sole Indian manufacturer with 8-10 Indian companies launching brands using their product
items.quote: Yes. So, we anticipate sales only from fluralaner right now coming through. That's gone off patent in March this year. And its doing quite well. There are close to about 8 to 10 Indian companies who have launched their brands. And all of the launches are with our product. We are the only manufacturer here in India for fluralaner.

items.statement: Afoxolaner patent expires in 2028; currently only supplying for development, no commercial sales
items.quote: 28, yes, that goes off patent in '28.

items.statement: Veterinary APIs constitute 95% of business; companion animal segment still nascent, bulk from farm animals
items.quote: No. Veterinary APIs is 95% of our business.

items.statement: US FDA filing targeted for October-December 2025; approval expected in 2027; 1-1.5 year approval timeline
items.quote: So, we hope to file by end of this calendar year. So, our initial filing is targeted in the October to December quarter. And typically, it takes about 1 year, 1.5 years to get the approval. We expect it to come in 27 year.

items.statement: EU sales declining 43% in FY25 as European companies lose market share in rest-of-world markets due to local manufacturing push
items.quote: So, when we sell to Europe, we are not selling them. That sale is mainly for the rest of the world market because when European companies are buying from us, they are manufacturing and reexporting. So, you don't need a European registration to sell that. And the European companies are slowly losing market share in the rest of the world area because of greater domestic competition because most of t

items.statement: Pakistan sales of INR 15 crores in FY25 will be zero in FY26 due to India-Pakistan conflict
items.quote: So, we -- our sales was to the tune of INR15 crores to Pakistan last year. And because of this India, Pakistan issue, now that sale is -- will be 0 in the current year.

items.statement: African market impacted by currency availability issues; customers face slow realizations due to USD shortage
items.quote: By current issues, | mean that the African countries don't have enough currency, U.S. dollars to pay for their imports.

items.statement: No plans to raise additional debt or equity beyond the 60-40 debt-equity for capex project
items.quote: No, we have not planned on raising any more debt or equity beyond what is planned for the project.

items.statement: Negative other income due to mark-to-market losses on current investments
items.quote: Yes, it is mark-to-market on the current investments.

items.statement: Margin pressure expected for 6-8 quarters due to new capacity operating costs before sales ramp up
items.quote: Yes, there will be increased operating cost, a little bit pressure on the margins till the actual sales start coming. So yes, there we anticipate for at least between 6 to 8 quarters, there we'll have a pressure.

items.statement: FY25 volume growth ~20% vs revenue growth 8.7% due to competitive intensity and lower realizations
items.quote: Now though we have got about a 9% sales growth over the earlier year, our volume growth is probably in the range of close to about 20%. And that is why even though we have got a 20% volume growth, we are looking at only a 9% revenue growth.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 18-22% range for FY26 and FY27
items.quote: we have always main tained approximately 18% to 22% as a broad range of EBITDA guidance. We continue to have our business geared toward s this range of EBITDA guidance

items.statement: Q1 and potentially Q2 FY26 EBITDA margins may be softer by 2-3 percentage points due to US tariff lag
items.quote: We see Q1 potentially slightly Q2 to be a little bit softer by only 2 to 3 percentage points, not more.

items.statement: Plan to open 20-25 ORIGEM stores by end of FY26
items.quote: We are expecting in this current financial year to have around 20 to 25 stores as per the current flow of plans.

items.statement: Target to double core B2B sales over next 3-4 years from FY25 base of ~$90 million
items.quote: There is certainly a possibility and visibility, and that is the aim to double our sales over the next 3 to 4 years in our core B2B business.

items.statement: Order book at INR 1,400 million as of March 31, 2025; additional INR 800 million order received in early May
items.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2025, was at about INR 1,400 million.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin at 22.4%; Q4 FY25 EBITDA grew 44.2% YoY
items.quote: FY 2025 EBITDA margin remained strong at 22.4%.

items.statement: ORIGEM stores operating at 42-45% gross margin
items.quote: ORIGEM is currently selling jewelry at a 42% to 45% gross margin.

items.statement: US tariff impact being passed to customers 5% each; some smaller customers taking full 10%
items.quote: We have already started splitting it with customers 5% each.

items.statement: US demand saw 2-3 week lull after tariffs; now seeing very good order flow and bullish customers
items.quote: As of today, we are seeing a very good order flow. A lot of customers are very bullish.

items.statement: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports contributed 81.8% of export sales mix in Q4 FY25 vs 54% in Q4 FY24
items.quote: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports contributed 81.8% to the over all export sales mix during Q4 FY '25 compared to 54% in Q4 FY '24

items.statement: Online revenue accounted for 29.5% of Q4 FY25 revenue
items.quote: Online revenue accounted for 29.5% of the revenue during Q4 FY '25.

items.statement: Board approved enabling resolution for fund raise up to INR 4 billion to accelerate ORIGEM expansion
items.quote: The Board of Goldiam has passed an enabling resolution for raising of funds not exceeding INR 4 billion.

items.statement: ORIGEM inventory per store is INR 2-2.5 crores on average
items.quote: The inventory per store that is being built at ORIGEM is between INR 2 crores to INR 2.5 crores on average.

items.statement: Receivables days reduced due to online sales growth (30% of revenue) with 10-30 day collection cycle
items.quote: Now this effectively is a negativ e working capital segment of a business for us, because the receivables from online sales come to Goldiam within 10 to 30 days

items.statement: Inventory buildup driven by B2B consignment testing and ORIGEM store setup; labor cost ~10-12% is main recycling cost
items.quote: The largest portion in terms of inventory at cost that gets lost when we recycle jewelry is just the labor that was required to produce that piece of jewelry.

items.statement: Top US customers have $500M-$2B buying power; Goldiam FY25 sales ~$90M
items.quote: Some of our largest customer s have buying power of between $500 million to $2 billion of buying, which is an addressable market to Goldiam

items.statement: ORIGEM priced 5-30% cheaper than funded lab-grown start-up competitors while maintaining 42-45% gross margin
items.quote: Like-to-like, we are 5% to 30% cheaper than funded start-ups in our industry so far.

items.statement: Large natural diamond retailers entering lab-grown likely to target 35-40%+ gross margins, not lower
items.quote: I think it's very easy for us to assume that they will not be selling lower than a 40% gross margin or 35% to 40% gross margin.

items.statement: Average realization: lab-grown diamond jewelry $742/unit, mined diamond jewelry $467/unit in Q4 FY25
items.quote: for lab-grown diamonds, I think we put this in our pres entation as well. I believe on Page 6 of our corporate deck, you will see the average realizat ion for Q4 FY '25 for lab-grown diamond jewelry, that was $742 per unit

items.statement: ORIGEM store breakeven model built at INR 20 lakh monthly revenue
items.quote: The model is built to do a breakeven around that INR 20 lakh monthly revenue figure.

items.statement: Board recommended INR 1 final dividend for FY25 plus two interim dividends of INR 1 each
items.quote: The Board recommended INR 1 as final dividend for FY '25 over and above t he 2 interim dividends, INR 1 each distributed during the year

items.statement: INR 4 billion fund raise is enabling resolution; not confirmed; will deploy if right opportunity arises
items.quote: this is an enabling resolution. It has not been confirmed yet. It's been set in the Board meeting and approved by the Board to allow us as management to be able to deploy funds faster, if and when we se e the

items.statement: Australia and Middle East markets in low single digits of revenue; US remains primary focus
items.quote: It is small. We had just star ted selling in Australia. Orders continue with the same retailer and wholesaler that we have started working with. It's not a large part of our overall revenue. I would say, it's still in low single digits

items.statement: India-UK FTA reduces duty from 2.5-3% to 0%; not a game changer; US FTA would be bigger tailwind
items.quote: Honestly, there was not a big duty to start with. It was about 2.5% to 3%. So that has become 0. It's not a game changer for the jewelry industry at least.

items.statement: Tariff impact transitory; not structural change to business model or margin profile
items.quote: It is not part of our business model, and not a long-term structur al change to our business model distribution or strength of our margin profile

items.statement: Hiring retail-experienced team to mitigate execution risk in ORIGEM expansion
items.quote: We are trying to mitigate it by having some of our team join us with peopl e wh o have multi-decade years of experience in the retail side of the business

items.statement: AUM grew 5% QoQ and 25% YoY in Q4 FY25 to ₹1,195 crore; loan book stood at ₹1,157 crore at year-end
items.quote: our AUM registered growth of 5% QoQ and 25% YoY in Q4, reaching ₹1,195 crore. Parallely, our loan book stood at ₹1,157 crore as of year-end.

items.statement: SME Retail to Wholesale AUM mix stands at 34:66 for FY25
items.quote: Currently, the SME Retail to Wholesale AUM mix stands at 34:66 for FY25.

items.statement: Target SME Retail share of 50-60% of AUM in next 18-24 months, up from 34% currently
items.quote: Our target was to increase our retail in last two years and we have targeted ourself to increase to 60% by FY27 and still we will strive for that. We may not be able to achieve that 60%, but definitely we will be in the range of 50 to 60% in next 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: Bare minimum AUM growth target of 20-25% YoY for FY26, with better guidance after two quarters
items.quote: definitely what kind of growth which we have achieved in last 2-3 years year on year, that should be the bare minimum we should be able to do.

items.statement: GNPA and NNPA rose 2 bps and 9 bps YoY in FY25 due to SME Retail slippages and Suvidha pilot project
items.quote: Slippages increased in FY25, resulting in a rise in GNPA and NNPA by 2 basis points and 9 basis points, respectively, over the previous financial year.

items.statement: Confident of decent recoveries from write-offs over next 12-18 months, with recoveries accruing from FY26
items.quote: we want to assure our stakeholders that the company is confident in making decent recoveries from these cases over the next 12 to 18 months. We should have a good track record in this domain, and recoveries from these elevated numbers should begin accruing from FY26.

items.statement: Net Interest Income grew 21% YoY to ₹146 crore in FY25; negative carry on excess liquidity dragged performance
items.quote: Net Interest Income stood at ₹146 crore in FY25, an increase of 21% YoY. NII performance could have been stronger if not for the negative carry on e xcess liquidity maintained during certain parts of the year

items.statement: PAT grew 14% YoY to ₹72 crore in FY25; higher provisioning, write-offs, and branch expansion costs impacted profitability
items.quote: PAT for the year stood at ₹72 crore, registering an increase of 14% YoY. PAT reflected the impact of higher provisioning, write-offs, and increased operating expenses from the recent branch expansion.

items.statement: Weighted IRR expected to remain stable despite new lower-yield prime product; new product to be 5-10% of total book
items.quote: the overall IRR, the weighted IRR will remain same . It's only that we are hiring, we are starting with the one product which we are a little lower IR R targeting the prime borrowers. But at the same time, we will be targeting with a little higher IRR less than 10 lakh kind of segment. So , the weighted IRRs will remain same more or less

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of ₹3 per equity share for FY25
items.quote: I am also pleased to announce that the Board has recommended a dividend of ₹3 per equity share.

items.statement: Senior and middle management hiring completed over last two years; future hiring only at branch level for next 12-18 months
items.quote: we invested into lot of senior team in last two years at middle level at the senior level. Now as we told last year also, so we will not be requiring people senior and middle level people for o ur expansion for next I would say 12 to 18 months. It will only be at the branch level
